StoryRevisionDetail.title: StoryRevisionDetail

base_revision_number.description: The version this edit started from (0 for no story yet). If the story has moved on, the save answers 409 and changes nothing. Omit to skip.
base_revision_number.title: Base Revision Number

SuggestionAcceptance.description: The story as the editor wants it; omitted, the visitor's text is used.
SuggestionAcceptance.title: SuggestionAcceptance

SuggestionCreate.description: A visitor's proposal: new story text, or a request in their own words.
SuggestionCreate.title: SuggestionCreate

schema.title: Response List Hidden People Api Admin People Hidden Get

get.description: The full revision history, newest first. For editors only: the public sees just the current revision, so text an editor removes from a story stops being public while the record of it is kept.

schema.title: Response List Story Revisions Api Admin People  Person Id  Story Revisions Get

post.description: Publish an earlier version again. It becomes a new version with the same text, so nothing is overwritten and the restore can itself be undone.

put.description: Hide a person from everything the public can read, or show them again. Their record and history are kept for the editors.

post.description: Accept a suggestion. An edit becomes a new revision, with the editor's changes if `story` is given. A request is marked as handled, because the editor acts on it separately.
Reject a suggestion. Its text is deleted straight away.

get.description: Search people by name, ordered by name. The search ignores case, accents and repeated spaces and matches any part of the name. An empty or missing `query` returns everyone. Results come in pages of `limit` people (1 to 100, default 50) starting at `offset` (0 or more); `total` counts every match, so clients can page through them with `offset`.

parameters.description: Part of a name; empty matches everyone
parameters.name: query

schema.description: Part of a name; empty matches everyone
schema.title: Query

delete.description: Delete a person who has no story, to undo a mistaken create. A person with a story returns 409 and is kept, because stories and their revisions are never deleted: no route edits or deletes them. Like every write, it goes through Authentik at the edge. No frontend calls it.

get.description: Read a person and their current story by ID. Neither frontend calls it (the public archive reads by slug, the editorial desk works from search results), but it is the canonical ID-based read: every mutation takes an ID, so integrations and the end-to-end test use it to check a write, and a deleted person reads as 404.
Read just the person's story: its current revision and how many revisions it has, without the person or the full history. No frontend calls it; it returns 404 for a person without a story.

post.description: Propose a change to a person's page: `edit` carries new story text and `request` describes a correction or removal in the visitor's own words. The only write open to the public, and it needs no login: nothing is published until an editor accepts it, and nothing about the visitor is stored.
